mentions.name: Mojave Studio
mentions.description: Mojave Studio is a Mac image editor featuring "Smart Folders," an equivalent to Photoshop Smart Objects. An embedded sub-document is shown inline (like examining shadow DOM in a web inspector) with its identity transform, while the rest of the document gets the inverse transform applied to show how it sits in context; sub-documents can be transformed with affine and/or homographic transforms.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm really pleased with how my equivalent to Smart Objects turned out in Mojave Studio, my Mac image editor.
